purpose: Neutral source registry for UPR-authored Claude Code and Codex capability adapters.

skills.name: new-feature

codexInterface.shortDescription: Build an ordinary UPR feature safely
codexInterface.defaultPrompt: Use $new-feature to implement this UPR feature with the correct risk gates and verification.

skills.riskRationale: Ordinary product implementation across UI, workers, money and messaging surfaces.

skills.name: masterplan

codexInterface.defaultPrompt: Use $masterplan to produce an evidence-backed, proportionate plan for this UPR initiative.

skills.riskRationale: Read-mostly planning. Authoring plan artifacts is a repository write; it grants no live authority.

skills.name: db-migration

codexInterface.shortDescription: Plan or author safe UPR database changes
codexInterface.defaultPrompt: Use $db-migration to plan or author this UPR database change without applying it unless separately authorized.

skills.riskRationale: Authors changes to the one Supabase project serving staging AND production. Planning and authoring are safe; the apply is separately gated.

skills.name: new-crm-module

codexInterface.shortDescription: Implement an active UPR CRM phase
codexInterface.defaultPrompt: Use $new-crm-module to implement this active CRM phase within its roadmap and ownership manifest.

skills.riskRationale: Implements an active CRM phase; touches product code, migrations via db-migration, and ownership-leased files.

riskTierContract: riskTier follows docs/tooling-governance.md section 3 (green|amber|red) and records BLAST RADIUS, not invocability. modelInvocable drives the human-only gates the renderer emits: disable-model-invocation (Claude) and policy.allow_implicit_invocation (Codex). Owner direction 2026-07-26: UPR gates the MUTATION, not the dispatcher, so a red-tier planner stays invocable and its live step is gated by .claude/hooks/block-destructive-sql.sh plus a separate owner authorization.
